business_requirement: Governed analytics + AI across business units on one set of definitions
criteria: Governance of data and AI in one plane; hybrid migration path; team skills; portability (open table format); cost model
chosen_design: Azure Databricks + Delta + Unity Catalog (alt: Snowflake + dbt)
evidence: Open Delta format limits lock-in; UC gives lineage + row/column security + model serving in one plane; candidate has delivery experience on it
trade_off: More platform engineering than Snowflake; DBU cost needs active FinOps
owner: Architect proposes / client platform team approves

business_requirement: Another engineer can run the PoC and reproduce outputs
options: Databricks Community/trial | Local PySpark | DuckDB + dbt in Docker
criteria: Runs in minutes, no account, deterministic, preserves contracts
evidence: Clean-env install verified on Linux; dbt gives contracts, tests, snapshots, lineage
trade_off: Not Spark: no distributed or streaming behaviour shown; SQL ports to Databricks with minor dialect changes

business_requirement: AI insight grounded in approved metrics and access policy; reproducible by reviewers
options: Hosted LLM API | Local model (Ollama) | Deterministic offline provider behind one interface
criteria: No API key available; reviewers must reproduce; safety must not depend on the model
chosen_design: Pluggable provider; offline deterministic default; Claude API/Ollama optional
ai_suggestion: AI first assumed an API key would be available
evidence: Candidate has only a chat subscription, no API key
trade_off: Offline parser understands fewer phrasings; but guardrails (metric whitelist, policy check, refusal) are identical across providers

business_requirement: Deliver all three submissions at the earliest
criteria: Rubric scores every deliverable; missing items cost more than shallow ones
chosen_design: Breadth-first; every required item covered; cuts documented
trade_off: Less depth in forecast, optional signals, IaC
